name: Brasilosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Crocodyloidea; Wikipedia suggests a tomistomine (Gavialidae) with Charactosuchus. Neither has been tested in a phylogenetic analysis.
sum: Late Miocene crocodylian from the Solimões Formation of Brazil, possibly a tomistomine.
holotype: Type material of B. mendesi from the Solimões Formation (Souza-Filho & Bocquentin-Villanueva 1989).
material: Known from the type material only.
biology: The sources say nothing about its biology.
author: Souza Filho and Bocquetin Villanueva 1989

sources.text: Cidade, G.M.; Fortier, D.; Hsiou, A.S. 2019. The crocodylomorph fauna of the Cenozoic of South America and its evolutionary history: a review. Journal of South American Earth Sciences 90: 392–411. doi:10.1016/j.jsames.2018.12.026
